items.title: AI로 하루 10권 '딸깍 출판'...커지는 전자책 시장 명암
items.excerpt: 생성형 AI로 하루 10권씩 전자책을 찍어내는 '딸깍 출판'이 늘며 전자책 시장이 커지는 한편, 저품질 도서에 대한 소비자 불만이 쌓이고 있다.

items.title: Secondhand Bookshops Face Strange Bulk Orders, Sellers Suspect AI Firms Are Buying Them for Training Data
items.excerpt: Secondhand booksellers in the UK and Ireland report unusual, machine-like bulk orders from unidentified buyers, raising speculation that AI companies are buying physical books for training data.

items.title: AI가 소설 쓰고 독자가 다음 화 바꾼다…문체부 R&D 웹소설, 일본 진출
items.excerpt: AI 콘텐츠 스타트업 모사재인이 문체부·콘진원 R&D 과제로 다중 AI 에이전트가 소설을 쓰고 독자 선택에 따라 다음 화가 바뀌는 일본 시장용 AI 웹소설 플랫폼을 선보였다.

items.title: CreateCrew advances AI to streamline webtoon animation, targets Japan, China
items.excerpt: Gyeonggi startup CreateCrew aims to standardize turning webtoons into animation with AI and is eyeing expansion into Japan and China.

items.title: Steins;Gate developer MAGES says AI translation is a long way from being viable for visual novels
items.excerpt: MAGES president and CEO Makoto Asada explained the studio's stance that AI translation is still far from good enough for text-heavy visual novels.

items.title: Sharjah Translation Award Debate Highlights Limits Of AI In Literary Translation
items.excerpt: Translators, academics and publishers at the Sharjah Translation Award seminar at SIBF 2026 said AI can speed up translation and research but cannot replace human literary judgment.

items.title: SIBF 2026: Does AI really pose a threat to writing? Booker winner Daisy Rockwell weighs in
items.excerpt: International Booker-winning translator Daisy Rockwell says AI has entered literature but its ability to produce quality literary translation remains suspect.

items.title: AI platform wins publishing award in Sharjah
items.excerpt: Brazilian platform KlooBR, which uses AI to edit, translate and proofread books in minutes, won the Disrupt Track award from Sharjah's Publishing Sustainability Fund, with SBA investment to open a Sharjah HQ.

items.title: Someone got an offline LLM running on a 2015 Kindle Paperwhite, even if it's quite slow
items.excerpt: A hobbyist got a small language model running fully offline on a jailbroken 2015 Kindle Paperwhite e-reader, slow but working.

items.title: The founder of DOU and Djinni built his own AI-powered e-reader with Claude
items.excerpt: Max Ishchenko, founder of Ukrainian IT sites DOU and Djinni, built his own reading service with built-in AI explanations and translations using Claude, and it even works with paper books.

items.title: 웹툰 번역·식자 '포토샵 안에서'…브레인벤쳐스, 어도비 장터 진출
items.excerpt: 브레인벤쳐스가 웹툰 번역과 식자 자동화 도구 '툰플로우'를 어도비 익스체인지에 정식 등록해 포토샵 안에서 AI 번역·식자를 처리하게 했다.

items.title: Editor's letter: Can AI predict the Booker winner? Not likely
items.excerpt: The Bookseller's editor asked AI to predict the Booker Prize winner and found its limitations plain to see.

items.title: AI와 출판산업, '정당한 거래 시장' 열리면 성장 동반자 될 수 있어
items.excerpt: 프랑크푸르트 호소문 등 국내외 출판계의 AI 학습 대응을 짚으며, 공정한 라이선스 거래 시장이 열리면 AI가 출판의 성장 동반자가 될 수 있다고 분석한다.

items.title: AI is pushing writers to make mistakes to prove they are human
items.excerpt: Some writers and students are deliberately adding language errors and abandoning their usual style, fearing AI-detection tools will flag their texts as machine-written.

items.title: AI detection trap: When machines put human creativity on trial
items.excerpt: An explainer on how AI-detection accusations, from Hachette's pulled BookTok horror title to flagged manuscripts, are putting authors' human creativity on trial.

items.title: Buddhasasana Minister 'Siddhartha the Selfish' book cover is AI-generated
items.excerpt: A viral book cover attributed to Sri Lanka's Buddhasasana minister is AI-generated; the title is misspelled and detection tools rate it 99% AI.

items.title: Sony's One-Punch Man movie gets caught in an AI storm after Yusuke Murata's comments spark fan debate
items.excerpt: One-Punch Man manga artist Yusuke Murata's comments on AI sparked a fan debate around Sony's live-action movie adaptation.

items.title: 연제구, 장애인·비장애인이 AI로 함께 쓴 에세이 『공감』 출간
items.excerpt: 부산 연제구 통합 프로그램에서 장애인·비장애인 수강생 15명이 AI를 활용해 공동 에세이집 『공감』을 출간했다.

items.title: '인간이 썼습니다'가 경쟁력⋯AI 시대, 책의 가치가 바뀐다
items.excerpt: AI 집필이 확산하자 출판사들은 계약·검증을 강화하고, 허위 인용·AI 집필 의혹으로 출간이 취소되며, 작가단체는 '사람이 쓴 책' 인증제를 도입하고 있다.

items.title: From AI Adoption to AI Practice: Building Governed AI in Scholarly Publishing
items.excerpt: How a publisher can make AI useful across the organization while keeping control of confidential information, editorial decisions and accountability.

items.title: Copyright Infringement Lawsuit Against OpenAI Draws More than 50 Amicus Briefs
items.excerpt: More than 50 amicus briefs in the authors' and publishers' copyright case against OpenAI map the fault lines of the most-watched AI lawsuit.

items.title: [문소영의 직격인터뷰] "미국 AI 기업의 국내 도서 대량 매집, 구한말을 보는 듯"
items.excerpt: 앤트로픽이 한국 신간 41만 권을 사들이고 AI 기업 배후로 추정되는 해외 업체들이 교보문고에 10만 종 구매를 제안한 가운데, 출판계는 저작권 대책을 요구하고 있다.

items.title: The Margin's flash fiction competition supports writers and denounces AI
items.excerpt: A student literary magazine's flash fiction competition fundraiser is positioned as a stand for human writers against AI-generated work.

items.title: AI on the bookshelf?
items.excerpt: As computer-generated text grows more sophisticated, publishers and readers want full disclosure about authors' use of AI.
